"放心吧，家里我还留了不少野物，打算明天去集市上卖呢！"

“当年，是占山叔救了我的性命！”

“前两日，又是你们家将大黄借给了我，这份恩情我李青山不会忘记额，快拿着吧！”

李青山说罢。

便将手中的野物，再次给赵山杏塞了回去。

“你这次，打了多少只野物？”

赵山杏听到李青山的话后，微微一怔，脸上闪过一抹好奇道。

见李青山这副神情，想必是打到了不少猎物才对。

可是。

他一个第一次上山的新人，能平安回来便算是不错了，怎么可能打到多少野物？

李青山能拎着两只野兔和一只野鸡，就已经让赵山杏感觉到意外了。

“这次上山的收获很不错，除了这些野兔和野鸡之外，还打到了三只大狍子。”李青山开口道。

三只狍子？

李青山话音落下，赵山杏精致的脸蛋上闪过一抹惊诧之色，上下打量着李青山道：“我记得你不会射箭吧，也是第一次上山？”

“骗你作甚。”

“刚刚村头的百姓都看到了，用不了多久，整个村子都会知道的。”

“我虽然是第一次上山，但我运气不错。”

“而且，我对弓箭这种东西，一摸就懂，拉满了就射，准头高的很，可能这就是天赋吧！”

李青山开口道。

自己的事情放在任何人身上，恐怕都不会有人相信，就算是李青山自己遇到了这样的事情，都会说那个人在吹牛。

“好吧！”

“不过，以后上山尽量小心，自己的性命最重要。”

“家中要是能多养几只猎狗的话，就尽量多养几只吧，我爹就是三条狗的命救回来的。”

赵山杏开口道。

要不是有那三条狗和关系好的猎人，赵占山早就交待在老林子里面了。

“嗯！”

李青山点了点头，继续道：“赶紧将这些野物炖了吃了，明天我再来一趟，给占山叔看看伤势。”

“怎么，你还会看病不成？”赵山杏笑着道。

“这些年，我不是一直和一个山里的老中医学医吗，肯定是会一些的，明天要去集市上买些针灸之类的，到时候露一手给你看看。”李青山道。

“行，那我可等着了。”

赵山杏掩嘴笑了笑后，便拎着野兔和野鸡朝着家中厨房走了过去。

李青山望着赵山杏修长笔挺的双腿，还有极细的小蛮腰，便忍不住暗自咂舌，真不愧是三朵金花之一。

王乃香，也就是赵贵的儿媳妇，小该负。

是偏向于柔弱气质，楚楚可怜的，浑身上下散发出的淡淡的奶香味，就像是一块奶油蛋糕，说话更是柔声细语。

破碎感满满。

即将坠落悬崖的可怜人，否则当初也不会选择自杀。

自己的嫂子，柳桂香，更像是一个知性大姐姐，思想成熟，做事麻利，是一个过日子的好手，日后但凡给她一些机会，日子都不会太差。

王春晓，也就是逃婚的那一个，在山中遇到的。

小小年纪，本钱极重，胸脯高耸。

完全就是一个小奶娘风格，而且有些奶凶，否则也不会离家出走，干出这个时代姑娘不敢迈出去的这一步。

至于赵杏儿。

腿长，腰细，长发，完全是一副邻家少女的感觉。

李青山所接触的这几个女人，每个人的性格和长相，都颇为不同。

“山杏，是青山来了吧？”

“怎么不进来啊？”

躺在床上的赵占山，声音有些虚弱，伤势明显加重了一些。

“爹，是李青山！”

“带了些野兔和野鸡来，对了，他还说明天再来一趟，给你看看伤势呢，说这些年都在和一个老中医学医。”

“这家伙，还是那样不靠谱。”

赵山杏在外面处理着野鸡和野兔，开口笑着道。

“山杏啊！”

“青山这孩子不错，至少还惦记着你爹的伤势，这个年月，还能将打到的野物送到咱们这来。”

“以后要是见到了，你们两个别互相挖苦。”

赵占山躺在床上，望着狭小窗户外的天空，眼神中满是悲凉之色。

自己的身体自己知道。

"Don't worry, I still have a lot of wild animals at home, and I plan to sell them at the market tomorrow!"

"It was Uncle Zhanshan who saved my life back then!"

"Two days ago, your family lent me rhubarb again. I, Li Qingshan, will never forget this kindness. Take it now!"

Li Qingshan said.

Then he stuffed the wild things in his hands back to Zhao Shanxing again.

"How many wild animals did you kill this time?"

After Zhao Shanxing heard Li Qingshan's words, he was slightly startled, and a hint of curiosity flashed on his face.

Seeing Li Qingshan's expression, he must have caught a lot of prey.

But.

As a newcomer who went up the mountain for the first time, it was considered good if he came back safely. How could he possibly hunt so many wild animals?

Zhao Shanxing was surprised that Li Qingshan could carry two hares and a pheasant.

"The harvest this time on the mountain was very good. In addition to these hares and pheasants, we also caught three large roe deer." Li Qingshan said.

Three roe deer?

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, a look of surprise flashed across Zhao Shanxing's delicate face. He looked Li Qingshan up and down and said, "I remember you don't know how to shoot, is this your first time going up the mountain?"

"Why did I lie to you?"

"Everyone in the village just saw it, and it won't take long for the whole village to know."

“Although it’s my first time going up the mountain, I’m lucky.”

"Besides, I can understand bows and arrows as soon as I touch them. I shoot when the draw is full. My accuracy is very high. Maybe this is my talent!"

Li Qingshan said.

If you put your own affairs on anyone, I'm afraid no one will believe it. Even if Li Qingshan encounters such a thing, he will say that person is bragging.

"Okay!"

"However, try to be careful when going up the mountain in the future. Your life is the most important thing."

"If we can have more hunting dogs at home, we should try to have as many as possible. My father was saved by the lives of three dogs."

Zhao Shanxing said.

If it weren't for the three dogs and the well-connected hunter, Zhao Zhanshan would have been left in the old forest.

"Yeah!"

Li Qingshan nodded and continued: "Hurry up and stew these wild animals and eat them. I will come back tomorrow to show Uncle Zhanshan his injuries."

"Why, can you still see a doctor?" Zhao Shanxing said with a smile.

"In the past few years, haven't I been working with an old Chinese medicine doctor from the mountains? He must know something about it. I'm going to the market tomorrow to buy some acupuncture and the like, and I'll show you my skills then." Li Qingshan said.

"Okay, then I'll be waiting."

After Zhao Shanxing covered her mouth and smiled, she carried the hare and pheasant and walked towards the kitchen at home.

Li Qingshan looked at Zhao Shanxing's slender and straight legs and extremely thin waist, and couldn't help but secretly smacked his lips. He really deserves to be one of the three golden flowers.

Wang Naixiang, who is Zhao Gui's daughter-in-law, should be blamed.

She tends to have a weak temperament, and is pitiful. Her whole body exudes a faint milky fragrance, like a piece of cream cake, and she speaks in a soft voice.

Full of brokenness.

The poor man was about to fall off the cliff, otherwise he would not have chosen to commit suicide in the first place.

My sister-in-law, Liu Guixiang, is more like an intellectual elder sister, mature in thinking, quick in work, and a good hand in getting along. As long as she is given some opportunities in the future, her life will not be too bad.

Wang Chunxiao, the one who escaped from marriage, met in the mountains.

At a young age, he has a lot of capital and a tall chest.

She is completely like a nanny, and she is a bit fierce, otherwise she would not run away from home and take a step that girls in this era dare not take.

As for Zhao Xinger.

With long legs, a slim waist, and long hair, she totally looks like a girl next door.

The personalities and looks of each of the women Li Qingshan came into contact with were quite different.

"Shanxing, is Qingshan here?"

"Why don't you come in?"

Zhao Zhanshan was lying on the bed, his voice was a little weak, and his injuries were obviously aggravated.

"Dad, it's Li Qingshan!"

"He brought some hares and pheasants. By the way, he also said he would come back tomorrow to show you the injury. He said he has been working with an old Chinese medicine doctor for these years."

"This guy is still so unreliable."

Zhao Shanxing was handling pheasants and hares outside and said with a smile.

"Mountain apricot!"

"Qingshan is a good boy. At least he is still thinking about your father's injury. In this day and age, he can still send the wild animals he kills to us."

"If we meet in the future, you two, please don't make fun of each other."

Zhao Zhanshan was lying on the bed, looking at the sky outside the narrow window, his eyes full of sadness.

Your body knows it.
